name: segmentation picks the most probable split under the unigram model
why: N = 1950. Costs in micro-nats: rust = round(1e6 ln(1950/400)) = 1584120, async = round(1e6 ln(1950/300)) = 1871802; total 3455922. rust + a + sync costs 1584120 + 773190 + 2564949 = 4922259, more. Every split with an unknown piece costs at least ln 1950 = 7575585 for that piece alone.
